## DntSpace 0.5.0

### Highlights

- Automatically migrates supported DntSpace 0.4.x databases to the typed session journal on first launch, with a pre-migration backup and archive report before the live database is replaced.
- Adds immediate per-profile Memory enable/disable controls without deleting retained data.
- Adds per-model context, maximum output, and modality settings.
- Hardens chat recovery, compaction, tool execution, child-agent delivery, plugin lifecycle, profile isolation, and startup reconciliation.
- Timed-out shell commands now return partial output with exit code 124 and can continue as managed background commands when configured.
- Improves settings navigation, thinking states, grouped tool activity, and large tool-output presentation.

If automatic database migration cannot validate the legacy database, DntSpace keeps the original database and writes details under `~/.dntspace/reports/legacy-epoch13-migration/` instead of resetting user data.
